draftNote: 2 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Mr_Meat31 (midlane→offlane), Cuban Noobster (jungle→carry).

coaching.headline: We never won a fight — zero fight wins to their four — and eight of our deaths directly bought their two Fangtooths and Orb Prime.
coaching.team: Every decisive fight was taken in their half without the people who were winning. At 9.7 (their Fangtooth) it went 0-2 while Kira was ahead in lane and mid never joined — Serath's 9.7 and Crunch's 9.8 deaths bought Fangtooth at 10. At 16.7 (their Fangtooth again) it went 2-4 with Crunch pinned in a losing lane, and the four deaths there bought Fangtooth at 17. At 20.0 we opened 4v5, 31 seconds after Ikra fell. At 21.9 (their Orb Prime) it went 0-3 with Kira ahead and absent again, and Orb Prime followed at 22. Items were not the excuse — at 21.9 we had 6 estimated online to their 4 — the numbers at the engage were. Carry and support both read ours all game: the call was shove those lanes, rotate five-strong, and only then touch their Fangtooth. One grounded note: Countess's 18k magical was their biggest damage source and the film flags Serath with no magic resist — the win was there.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Numbers at the objective: we contested their Fangtooth and Orb Prime short-handed while our two winning lanes were elsewhere — they cashed two of their four fight wins into majors, and with zero fight wins we had nothing to cash.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Ikra's macro was the lever, and that's where the game leaked: caught alone at 11.7 and again at 19.5, and the 19.5 pick meant the 20.0 fight opened 4v5 — lost before it started. At 9.7 Mr_Meat31 was alive and never joined the 0-2 at their Fangtooth. Cross the map with a teammate and be there when the team commits.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: The lane read Goldilocks324's way all game against Eden — and the team never got to use it. In the two fights that handed over Fangtooth and Orb Prime (9.7 and 21.9) Goldilocks324 was alive and ahead in lane but absent; a shove-and-rotate there flips a 0-2 or 0-3 into a numbers advantage. The lead was real, it just never reached the fights that decided the game.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Four of Cuban Noobster's five deaths directly preceded an enemy major: 9.7 → their Fangtooth at 10, 16.8 → Fangtooth at 17, 20.7 and 21.9 → Orb Prime at 22 — all in their half. That's what a death costs on an objective timer: don't be first in at their Fangtooth without five. One build note the file flags: no magic resist into a 3-magical comp led by Countess.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Countess had the lane all game — both of Xeebs' solo catches (3.9 and again at 14.4) came outside any fight, and the 9.8 death at their Fangtooth helped buy the 10-minute take. With the lane pinned, shove and hug tower rather than holding the river line. The 16.7 and 21.9 fights were the wrong team calls with Xeebs' lane in that state; those weren't Crunch's to win.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Support read Willy Guggenheim's way all game against Zinx, and at 20.0 Willy was alive and ahead while the team fought 4v5 — that shove-and-rotate was the missing body. The 16.8 death in the 2-4 Fangtooth fight fed the 17-minute take: when the numbers are wrong at the engage, the honest support call is to not follow the team in.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.8s of lockdown): Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Countess. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight

ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

enemyKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive

enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Pounce, grow with Behemoth and out-sustain the fight

enemyKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he front-lines and CCs
enemyKits.playAgainst: anti-heal and kiting beat his sustain brawl; burst him before Behemoth

enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely

rampage.loadout: Krix (Regenerative Tissue + Feeding Frenzy), augment Tiny Titan, crest Razorback
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 22 minutes, fewer deaths than about 84% of Rampage jungle players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Behemoth at rank 2: 120s base, about 111.1s by the end (7% shorter) from 8 ability haste: Tainted Guard 8.
Rampage dealt 15,177 hero damage, 23% of their team's, with +45 physical power from items.
Fire Blossom (item): Burn nearby Enemy Units: Deals 15 (+1%) Damage each second.Firestorm - When Heatwave damages a Target: Deals 5% more damage each second, up to 40%.
Tainted Guard (item): On being hit by a Basic Attack: Reduce the Source's Healing by 45% for 3s. Apply a Bleed dealing 30 (+30%) Damage over 3s.
Razorback (crest): Gain 20% Physical Armor and Magical Armor for 5s. Reflect 15% of Pre-Mitigated Damage received from Heroes as Damage.
Tiny Titan (augment): Behemoth shrinks Rampage instead, granting him 25/27.5/30% Total Attack Speed, but he receives 45% more damage.
Sustain: Tainted Guard: On being hit by a Basic Attack: Reduce the Source's Healing by 45% for 3s. Apply a Bleed dealing 30 (+30%) Damage over 3s.; 19,550 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1055 health, +113 physical armor, +5 magical armor; took 37,159 damage, mitigated 44,969, died 1 times.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Rampage killed built physical armor (Phase). We killed Rampage 1 time.
Copy it? Krix (Regenerative Tissue + Feeding Frenzy): 55.4% in 193 Rampage jungle games, above the hero's 50.4%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

fedBy: Tainted Scepter (Malice): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice.• Stacks up to 15 times.• Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly.• Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
lines: Lead story: Healed through fights. 528 healing a minute, more than 85% of Zinx support players this patch.
Neural Regenesis at rank 2: 135s base, about 108s by the end (20% shorter) from 25 ability haste: Tainted Scepter 10, Orion 15.
9 takedowns (1 kills, 8 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice).
Zinx dealt 5,471 hero damage, 8% of their team's, with +155 magical power from items.
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Orion (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Deal 2% increased damage to the Target for 3.5s, up to a maximum of 16%.
Tranquility (crest): Heal yourself and nearby Heroes by 150 (+70%). Also grant 10% Damage Mitigation for 2s.
Exarch (Eternal): Healing or Shielding a target (including yourself) grants them 10% Total Attack Speed and empowers their Basic Attacks to deal 10% bonus Magical Damage On-Hit for 4s.

Sustain: Tainted Scepter: On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.; Tranquility: Heal yourself and nearby Heroes by 150 (+70%). Also grant 10% Damage Mitigation for 2s.; Fervour: Basic Attacks against Enemy Heroes heal you and allies within 1000 units for 2 (+0.5 per level)(+5% Magical Power).; 11,624 healing recorded.
Toughness: +300 health; took 13,132 damage, mitigated 5,684, died 2 times.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 5 effects on one trigger: Tainted Scepter, Tranquility, Exarch, Fervour, Heal Matrix.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Orion, Exarch, Fervour.
The Eternal was part of it: Exarch (Revelation + Fervour) sits on the same triggers as the items (healing off the damage; every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 1 players Zinx killed built magical armor. Anti-heal on Kira, Serath, Crunch, Phase. We killed Zinx 2 times.
Copy it? Exarch (Revelation + Fervour): 48.5% in 1,108 Zinx support games, level with the hero's 48%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.
